blocks.text: NEW YORK — Angel Reese was sitting at home watching the end of the WNBA Finals last season when she tweeted “ manifesting the finals.” Exactly 364 days later, Reese is there after helping Atlanta reach the WNBA Finals for the first time since 2013 with a 22-point effort in the Dream’s 85-83 win over the New York Liberty on Friday night. “Sat at home the last two years and watched it,” Reese said of the championship round. “I texted Kah (Kahleah Copper), just get me one game in the playoffs.” READ: WNBA: Disputed timeout leaves Liberty reeling and down 2-0 […]...
